title: PHP invoice download
context: Lets a signed-in customer download one of their own invoices as a PDF. Invoice files are stored as /var/invoices/<id>.pdf. Sessions are already started by bootstrap.php, which sets $_SESSION['user_id'] for signed-in users.
code: $stmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT id, customer_id, number FROM invoices WHERE id = ?');

expected.why: the invoice's customer_id is never compared with the signed-in user, so any customer can download anyone's invoice
the path is built from the raw request value rather than the database id, so ../ in id reads other files
